Summary.en: Renders the result of a Datasource query as an HTML table with an optional Excel export.
Summary.de: Stellt das Ergebnis einer Datasource-Abfrage als HTML-Tabelle mit optionalem Excel-Export dar.
Summary.it: Visualizza il risultato di una query Datasource come tabella HTML con esportazione Excel opzionale.

Parameter.Columns: REQUIRED - A CSV defining the columns to show. Each column is 'label;datacolumn;jsonFlag' with an optional fourth entry ';width', e.g. 'Anrede;Anrede;false,Unternehmen;Unternehmen;true,Nachricht;Nachricht;false;30'.
Parameter.DataQuery: REQUIRED - The name of the Datasource-Query on the Formcycle server whose result shall be displayed.
Parameter.CSS: Optional string of one or more (space separated) CSS classes to apply to both the tagged container and the injected table.
Parameter.FileName: The name of the exported Excel file without extension (the extension is always .xlsx). Defaults to 'Export'. When an Excel export is requested, set a sensible value derived from the query name (strip the datasource prefix/extension), e.g. the query 'INHALT.Altstadtfest_2027' -> 'Altstadtfest_2027'. Never set a boolean or an empty value.
Parameter.SheetName: The name of the worksheet within the exported Excel file. Defaults to 'sheet1'. When an Excel export is requested, set a sensible value derived from the query name (same readable core as the filename, max about 31 characters), e.g. 'Altstadtfest_2027'. Not the technical query name and never a boolean or empty.
Parameter.ExportButton: A REQUIRED CSS CLASS selector (starts with '.', NEVER an '#id' or a boolean 'true'/'1') of a REAL button that triggers the export/download of the Excel file. Only a class selector resolves to the actual '<button>' element; an ID selector resolves to the XButtonList wrapper, so no click handler is attached and the export does nothing. When an Excel export is requested, a dedicated export button (an XButtonList with a single NON-navigation button - NO action, not a send button) must be created with the stable class 'CodBi_Table_View_ExportButton', placed as a SIBLING of the DQ.Table.View container (NEVER inside its elements array - the table is rendered inside that container), and this parameter must be set to that generated button's class selector, e.g. '.CodBi_Table_View_ExportButton'.
Parameter.Centered: Whether the content of the table cells is centered. Defaults to true; set to false/0/no to keep cells left-aligned.
Parameter.ExcludeColumns: Optional CSV of column names (matched against label or datacolumn) that shall be excluded from the Excel export (they remain visible in the table).
Parameter.UrlPartToReplace: Optional CSV of URL parts that shall be replaced in every URL rendered as text inside a cell (and in the Excel export). Only applied when UrlPartReplacement is set as well; both CSVs are combined by position (first entry with the first entry, second with the second, ...).
Parameter.UrlPartReplacement: Optional CSV of replacements for UrlPartToReplace, combined by position. An empty entry removes the corresponding part from the URL.

Columns.default: A CSV defining the columns to show. Each column is 'label;datacolumn;jsonFlag' with an optional fourth entry ';width', e.g. 'Anrede;Anrede;false,Unternehmen;Unternehmen;true,Nachricht;Nachricht;false;30'. When the user skips the column definition, this may be left FULLY EMPTY (data-cb-columns="") - the table then renders EMPTY (no columns) and the user adds the CSV later in this functionality's CSV editor.

DataQuery.default: REQUIRED - The name of the Datasource-Query on the Formcycle server whose result shall be displayed.

CSS.default: Optional string of one or more (space separated) CSS classes to apply to both the tagged container and the injected table.

FileName.default: REQUIRED whenever an Excel export is requested - MUST be set to a sensible value (never left at the bare 'Export' default and never omitted). The name of the exported Excel file without extension (the extension is always .xlsx). Derive the value from the query name (strip the datasource prefix/extension), e.g. the query 'INHALT.Altstadtfest_2027' -> 'Altstadtfest_2027'. Never set a boolean or an empty value.

SheetName.default: REQUIRED whenever an Excel export is requested - MUST be set to a sensible value (never left at 'sheet1' and never omitted). The name of the worksheet within the exported Excel file. Derive the value from the query name (same readable core as the filename, max about 31 characters), e.g. 'Altstadtfest_2027'. Not the technical query name and never a boolean or empty.

ExportButton.default: A REQUIRED CSS CLASS selector (starts with '.', NEVER an '#id' or a boolean 'true'/'1') of a REAL button that triggers the export/download of the Excel file. Only a class selector resolves to the actual '<button>' element; an ID selector resolves to the XButtonList wrapper, so no click handler is attached and the export does nothing. When an Excel export is requested, a dedicated export button (an XButtonList with a single NON-navigation button with NO action - 'keine Aktion' (no action), not a send button) must be created with the stable class 'CodBi_Table_View_ExportButton', placed as a SIBLING of the DQ.Table.View container (NEVER inside its elements array - the table is rendered inside that container), and this parameter must be set to that generated button's class selector, e.g. '.CodBi_Table_View_ExportButton'. WHENEVER an Excel export is requested the SAME container MUST carry ALL SIX attributes together (data-cb-func, data-cb-dataquery, data-cb-columns, data-cb-filename, data-cb-sheetname, data-cb-exportbutton) - never only the first three. The stable class goes into the button's `cssclasses` property - there is NO `classNames` property on an XButtonList button, so NEVER write `classNames:[...]` (it is ignored and the selector matches nothing, so the export never triggers). The XButtonList item must be emitted as a valid top-level item starting `{ `className` => `XButtonList` }` (a single open brace; a double-brace `{{` prefix corrupts the JSON and makes the item be dropped as an unknown/null className). The button's VISIBLE LABEL MUST be exactly 'Export Excel' and MUST live in the buttons[].value property (value = Excel') - Formcycle renders buttons[].value as the button's visible text; `title` is a separate optional TOOLTIP and is NEVER the button label (a button with the label in `title` and an empty value '' renders an EMPTY button), so value MUST NEVER be empty. Never use 'Senden'/'Absenden'/'Einreichen' as the label (those are send-labels); the export button is NOT a send button. NO WORKFLOW: the DQ.Table.View export runs ENTIRELY CLIENT-SIDE via the functionality - this export button is a pure click-handler and MUST NOT create any Formcycle workflow/task/node (no FC_EXPORT_*, no FC_RETURN_FILE, no export lane) and MUST NOT be treated as (or renamed to) a 'Senden'/submit trigger. Formcycle stores the action dropdown's machine value in action.optionId; for 'keine Aktion' set the button's action to {"page":"","check":false,"customAction":"","customClassNames":"","displayName":"","optionId":"no action","value":""}. A missing or wrong optionId makes the designer render the button as 'absenden + prüfen' (submit + validate), which submits the form instead of exporting - a FAIL. This no-action export button is the ONLY NON-submit XButtonList button - do NOT apply the submit-button rule to it.

Centered.default: Whether the content of the table cells is centered. Defaults to true; set to false/0/no to keep cells left-aligned.

ExcludeColumns.default: Optional CSV of column names (matched against label or datacolumn) that shall be excluded from the Excel export (they remain visible in the table).

UrlPartToReplace.default: Optional CSV of URL parts that shall be replaced in every URL rendered as text inside a cell (and in the Excel export). Only applied when UrlPartReplacement is set as well; both CSVs are combined by position (first entry with the first entry, second with the second, ...).

UrlPartReplacement.default: Optional CSV of replacements for UrlPartToReplace, combined by position. An empty entry removes the corresponding part from the URL.
